create_fluid_paint_environment: create a FluidPaint RL environment with configurable canvas, grid, brush sizes, and episode length
run_fluid_paint_step: run a FluidPaint environment step with action dict containing control, end, flag, speed, size, red, green, blue, alpha
test_fluid_paint_reset: test the FluidPaint environment reset method that initializes the canvas and brush parameters
review_fluid_paint_observation: review the FluidPaint observation method that returns canvas, episode_step, episode_length, and action_mask
summarize_fluid_paint_action_spec: summarize the FluidPaint action_spec method that returns discrete specs for control, end, flag, speed, size, red, green, blue, alpha
